user.title: Set up Voice Timers
user.description: Adds named voice timers ("set a washer timer for 50 minutes") with repeating ring announcements. Configure timer slots and other options after setup, from this integration's Configure button.

data_description.timer_slots: How many named timers can run at once.
data_description.override_builtin_timer: When on (default), unnamed timer commands like "set a timer for 10 minutes" route through this integration's timer pool with repeating ring announcements. When off, unnamed commands fall back to Home Assistant's built-in timer instead — turn this off if you want to keep using core's timer alongside named timers from this integration. Named timer commands ("set a washer timer for 10 minutes") always go through this integration either way.
data_description.ring_repeat_seconds: How often the "[name] timer is done" announcement repeats while a finished timer is still ringing.
data_description.ring_max_minutes: Safety cutoff so a forgotten timer doesn't announce forever.
